description: Formulas for calculating Roe and Aged Roe prices from fish prices

roe.notes: Fish ponds produce roe every 4 days typically. Base roe price depends on the fish species.

agedRoe.notes: Roe processed in preserves jar doubles in value. Sturgeon Roe becomes Caviar instead.

caviar.notes: Special case: Sturgeon Roe → Caviar (not Aged Roe)
